title: Day Type (switch)
statementMd:
A `switch` chooses between many fixed values without a long if / else-if chain. Given a day number (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday), print `Weekday`, `Weekend`, or `Invalid day`.

**Input**
One integer `day`.

**Output**
`Weekday`, `Weekend` or `Invalid day`.

Use `switch` — note that several cases can share one result.
hints: Cases with no code fall through to the next one, so `case 6: case 7:` share a result.
Every branch needs a break (or it falls into the next one), and default catches the rest.
